Q: I'm trying to learn how to sew, but I keep making mistakes. What am I doing wrong?

A: It's totally normal to make mistakes when learning a new skill like sewing! Here are some helpful tips to keep in mind:

Q: Do I need to have a very steady hand for sewing?

A: No, you don't need to have the most steady hand in the world to sew. It does help to be somewhat steady, but you can learn to compensate for any wobbles by taking your time and practicing. Slow and steady wins the race!

Q: Should I use the same thread color as my fabric?

A: Not necessarily. While using a matching thread color can make things look neater, it's not always necessary. If you're using a light colored fabric, a dark thread will show up more.
